name.full: Workplace Concierge - desk and room booking with interactive widgets

description.short: Find and book desks and meeting rooms with an interactive office map.
description.full: A declarative agent that helps employees find and book desks and meeting rooms, see who is in the office, and manage their bookings. Its MCP server renders interactive seat-map and bookings widgets inline in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat using MCP Apps.
